plainText:
Gary's Electivire (Japanese: シゲルのエレキブル Shigeru's Elekible) was a that in the Sinnoh region. It is the first Pokémon known to have been obtained by him after he became a .

==In animation==
==== ====
 
Electivire was during Gary's journey through Sinnoh sometime during his research in this region. 

Its first appearance was in Home Is Where the Start Is!. It looked as if it was a wild at first because it was shooting apples by itself from a tree with its . attempted to take it by capturing it in an electricity-proof net. It looked as if they were about to succeed until Gary showed up and told it to use to cut free of the net. In the end, it zapped and blasted Jessie, James, and Meowth off with to finish.

 was impressed by Electivire, but as he looked it up on his Pokédex, there was no data on it. Ash then wanted to battle it, but Gary said to come back to the lab first. Once there, Ash sent out his to fight Electivire. Unfortunately for him, Electivire proved too much for Pikachu to handle and he ended up losing. When Gary left for Sinnoh, he took Electivire with him. 

==== ====
 
Electivire appeared again in Ill-Will Hunting! as it fought by Gary's side against Pokémon Hunter J and her henchmen in order to protect the from being captured. It was called on again to sabotage J's ship, using Thunderbolt to cause explosions and then tackling J's henchmen with to allow Ash to retrieve Shieldon.

Gary used Electivire and Umbreon to battle against Saturn's Toxicroak in The Needs of the Three!, when trying to stop Pokémon Hunter J from giving the three to the Team Galactic . However, had both of them under control at all times. When Electivire attempted to use to stop Hunter J, it was badly hurt by Toxicroak's before it could attack.

==== ====
Gary used Electivire to battle against a wild in Advice to Goh!, alongside Ash's Pikachu. After landing a Thunder attack, Moltres flew off, but not before leaving a burning feather behind, allowing Gary to complete his Trial Mission and earn a token from Project Mew.

In In the Palms of our Hands!, Gary used Electivire alongside Horace's , Danika's , and Quillon's to battle . Despite their best efforts, the Pokémon were easily defeated.

===Personality and characteristics===
 
Since its introduction, Electivire has also become one of Gary's most used Pokémon. In contrast to Paul's Electivire, Gary's Electivire seems to be more jolly and sportful, as seen in its debut and battle with Ash's Pikachu.
